pose: Close-up wide-angle shot from ground level. A single massive, broad tridactyl footprint dominates the foreground, filling 60% of the screen. dino_bones_paleontologist_4's torso and head are visible in the background as he kneels *inside* the heel of the print. The print is significantly wider than his waist. Massive displacement rims of mossy mud surround the deep crater of the track.
